annotation.title_clean: სწავლა-სწავლების პროცესში ხელოვნური ინტელექტისა (AI) და მონაცემების გამოყენების ეთიკური გზამკვლევი განათლების სპეციალისტებისთვის
annotation.title_en: Ethical guidelines on the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and data in teaching and learning for educators
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission (Directorate-General for Education, Youth, Sport and Culture); Georgian edition by Centre for Education and Research (CEI) / EU Delegation to Georgia
annotation.venue: EEAS (Publications Office of the European Union)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Georgian-language edition of the European Commission's 2024 ethical guidelines for educators on using AI and data in teaching and learning. It applies the Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI requirements (transparency, fairness, oversight, privacy, accountability) through guiding questions, scenarios and competence-building advice for schools. No embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines for teachers and school leaders on ethical use of AI and data in education
Builds on the Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI and ALTAI, with attention to the AI Act and GDPR
Guiding questions cover transparency, non-discrimination, human oversight, privacy and accountability
Use cases include student dashboards and AI support for special educational needs
Recommends AI literacy and competence development for educators
